stories.title: A man named Hitler Mussolini is elected mayor in Peru
stories.summary: Official results showed Hitler Mussolini Simeón Flores winning the mayor's race in Queropalca, a district in Peru's Andes, with 34.5% of the vote. The ONPE results screen with his name at the top went around the world in English, Spanish and Portuguese posts, and BBC World's headline "Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru" got 42K likes. Replies joked about what his parents were thinking and how the name got past a registry clerk.
